description: kcore parity cross-SDK vectors: full signed molecules (metadata, value transfer, token creation, wallet creation) at OTS v1 and v2, with unique and with colliding createdAt. Every kcore-capable SDK re-signs each molecule with kcore on and off and must reproduce molecularHash and every otsFragment byte for byte. Regenerate only via scripts/gen-kcore-parity-vectors.mjs; never hand-edit.

molecules.producer: JS SDK dist (KNISHIO_KCORE=off), cross-checked under KNISHIO_KCORE=require
